summary: A commitment becomes more meaningful when you understand what it will ask of you after the romantic, exciting, or hopeful part becomes ordinary.
body: A commitment becomes more meaningful when you understand what it will ask of you after the romantic, exciting, or hopeful part becomes ordinary. When Venus conjuncts Saturn, affection and value meet responsibility, making relationships, financial agreements, creative commitments, or promises feel more serious because time and consequence are now part of the decision. This does not have to make commitment feel heavy. It gives you a chance to choose the obligation knowingly and make sure the time, money, loyalty, or work it requires is something you can keep giving without resenting what you chose.
